project-hooks.yaml:
repos:
  - repo: file:///cache/hook-repo
    rev: fixture-source-v3.19.1
    hooks:
      - id: pyupgrade
        args: [--py39-plus]
        files: ^test_fixture\.py$
verify-hook-environment.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
interpreters = list(Path('/cache/pre-commit').glob('repo*/py_env-*/bin/python'))
assert len(interpreters) == 1, interpreters
subprocess.run([str(interpreters[0]), '-c', "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('pyupgrade') == '3.19.1'; assert version('tokenize-rt') == '6.1.0'; print('Pinned hook environment versions verified')"], check=True)
